summary: BUGFIX-001 (PropManage Cartea Casei / DocumentVault upload sheet) — frontend end-to-end validated on Mobile (390x844, has_touch=True, is_mobile=True, iPhone UA — pointer:coarse=true) and Desktop (1920x800, has_touch=False — pointer:fine=true). The .cv2-fade animation-fill-mode='backwards' fix in index.css is confirmed (line 768). All 8 acceptance criteria from the review request PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css:768 — .cv2-fade uses 'backwards' as required. If regressed to 'both', the residual transform matrix on v2-property-view would once again render position:fixed descendant Sheets off-screen (previously at y=2754).

DocumentVault card on desktop is wrapped in a `lg:hidden` ancestor inside the Property view — accessible only after clicking hub-subnav-carte (subnav tab). This is intentional (desktop uses subnav routing) but worth noting: vault-add-btn is initially display:none on desktop until user selects 'Cartea casei' subnav.

Sheet component (ui.jsx) uses fixed inset-0 as backdrop covering full viewport on both viewports — inner card is centered on desktop via items-end/items-center flex. Bounding-box 0/0/1920/800 reflects the backdrop, not the visible card.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded 2 small PNG test documents (test_doc.png mobile + test_desktop.png desktop) into the existing demo client's vault to exercise the end-to-end persistence path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUGFIX-001 fully validated. Do NOT regress .cv2-fade animation-fill-mode from 'backwards' to 'both'. On desktop, DocumentVault is behind hub-subnav-carte (click required). The memory-celebration modal (z-90) appears after first document upload of the session and blocks subsequent taps until dismissed — testing agents should either dismiss it or continue in a fresh flow.

rca of the issue: Original bug: .cv2-fade{animation-fill-mode:both} in index.css kept a transform matrix() on the .cv2-fade element (v2-property-view container) permanently after the fadeUp animation completed. Because CSS `transform` establishes a containing block for position:fixed descendants, the vault-upload-sheet (fixed inset-0) was positioned relative to the transformed parent and ended up at y≈2754 (off-screen). Fix: change fill-mode to 'backwards' (index.css:768) so the transform is only applied before the animation starts, not retained after. Regression test: on mobile, opening vault-upload-sheet now yields bounding box y=0, h=844 — inside viewport.
